title: BILL (Bill.com) - Cloud AP/AR automation platform for SMBs
clean_text: BILL (formerly Bill.com) is a cloud-based financial operations platform that automates accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR), integrating payments, expense management, cash flow forecasting, and procurement with AI-assisted workflows. It serves nearly 500,000 small and medium-sized businesses and growing enterprises, positioning itself as a key enabler of digital transformation in B2B financial operations. BILL reports an average 50% time savings on accounts payable tasks for customers who automate previously manual processes.

meta.target: small and medium-sized businesses, growing enterprises
meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, per-user plus transaction fees
